summary: Expose local SPEC audit via health/drift surfaces (#340): plate_health/gh plate health include status/counts/next_step; plate_what_next prioritizes actionable findings; CLI --repo-root/--no-spec-audit; never auto-writes SPEC.md.
migration_impact: Health JSON gains additive fields (spec_audit_status, spec_audit_counts, spec_audit_actionable_count, spec_audit_next_step). Agents should route actionable status to gh plate spec-audit / --followups before generic epic work. Optional --no-spec-audit skips the local audit.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core for health SPEC audit fields (#340).
2. Run gh plate health [--repo-root PATH] or plate_health; inspect spec_audit_*.
3. When status=actionable, run gh plate spec-audit --json then --followups as needed.
4. Use --no-spec-audit / no_spec_audit only for pure remote label/protection checks.
agent_notes: CLI/MCP audit already from #338/#339. Prefer finishing open PRs over SPEC drift. Never auto-write SPEC.md; human-approval gate remains. Quiet: one-line health SPEC audit status unless asked for full findings.
